usedFor: Each “New Screen” in Brix opens a rollout project in Asana.

bestTemplate.name: “New Screen” in Brix, then “Create Project” in Asana
bestTemplate.why: A new screen means setup work, and “New Screen” can be limited to one location.

watchOut: “Create Project” runs every time, so narrow the trigger to a location if you track only some sites.
